changelog:
## v1.9.32

- Conditional Style Rendering: Style tab sections are now strictly separated by mode (Single Product style controls only show in Single mode, and Bundle style controls only show in Bundle mode)
- Looping Countdown Urgency Timer: Added repeating evergreen countdown timer option inside Bundle Summary Bar with custom duration and complete styling controls
- Before-Checkout Features & Badges: Added new customizable section before checkout form with Icon, Title, Short Description, repeater items, and full styling controls
- Enhanced Selected Badge: Removed default box-shadow, added full styling controls, and introduced Top-Right Corner Rotated Ribbon style
